title: a harness invocation that is not in the table of no-session commands is denied, a table flag followed by more words included
source: intended: docs/decisions.md, section "Only launches are blocked, and launches into other repositories" (the guard denies only what starts an agent)
intent: Deny by default: the first word after the harness must be in the table. A flag of the table followed by anything but a redirection is denied (claude --version -p x, claude --help then a prompt), and so is a table flag that comes after another word (claude -p x --help). claude plugin eval runs agent sessions and is denied; claude config is no subcommand of Claude Code, so its word would be a prompt.

reason.regex: ^JITSO owns worker launch in this project: a harness starts only through (bun run jitso|jitso) launch --build <id> --brief <file> --mode <mode>, never as a program of its own\. .*\(denied: (claude|codex|opencode|pi)\)$
